findings.title: Frozen AM constraint reactions are not zero load support
findings.counterexample: Unit grid mass with vz=-1 clamped to zero receives +1 impulse; the fixed AM reaction is -1.
findings.minimum_fix: Distinguish nonzero constraint reaction from missing AM-AM load transfer, rigid-body dynamics and identifiable phase load sharing; leave W4 cause unseparated.
findings.limits: No new measurement of actual W4 load magnitude or causal fraction.

findings.title: Bilateral and unilateral platen conditions differ even during descent
findings.counterexample: Descending platen velocity=-1 and bed velocity=-2: 3D clamps to -1 with negative wall impulse; 2D leaves -2 and adds no impulse.
findings.minimum_fix: Withdraw compression-only equivalence; scope S/F inference to their common unilateral boundary and specify a relative-separation boundary test.
findings.limits: Does not establish frequency or size of this effect in the future benchmark.

findings.title: K_safe lacks a relative support-displacement bound
findings.counterexample: Support gap 1.5 cells and each body's one-cell displacement bound allow two-cell relative closure; a graph padded by only one cell misses the pair.
findings.minimum_fix: Define support-set movement bounds, pairwise summed or explicitly relative dilation, periodic/deformation handling, and recolour/fallback before a violating P2G.
findings.limits: No actual K_safe, colouring or collision frequency was measured.

findings.title: Nearest reassignment is not a conservative multibody occupancy bound
findings.counterexample: Three coincident equal sphere supports require a 3-clique, but union raster plus deterministic nearest-ID tie assignment retains only one body.
findings.minimum_fix: Preserve seed parent IDs and separately count all original support regions in compressed-geometry stress tests; label union/Voronoi results as observed reconstruction, not a worst-case upper bound.
findings.limits: Logical synthetic counterexample only; it does not claim coincident grains exist in real_14 or measure its undercount.

findings.title: Existing C-prime code has unlisted lock parameters
findings.counterexample: At fixed sigma_y=.15, R*=.25, E*=13.186813, delta=.05 and klock=8, beta=.06 vs .30 changes scalar contact force by 51.72066 times.
findings.minimum_fix: Declare C_H, beta_lock and klock with provenance and whether retained, removed or fixed independently; count unsourced choices under existing section 3-2 rules.
findings.limits: Future C-prime may remove the lock branch; no alternative parameters are selected and no full DEM outcome is inferred.

conditional_checks_not_escalated_to_find: Memory and seed rounding near integer lattice shell; new exact geometry not registered.
real_14 count mass implies phi=.843177 at 50x50x30.3, not the appendix's .88 height assumption.
Colour field bytes and cap produce theoretical upper bounds, not allocation certification.
